'''Ootaks''' were [[Primate/Legends|primates]] from [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]]. They were known for searching out fermented [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] and proceeding to gorge until intoxicated. [[The Drunken Ootak]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Umalor]] on Vinsoth, was named after the creature.<ref name="Allies" />
